opening.argument: The invitation is direct and tied to a packaged opportunity. The speaker calls OneCoin “the opportunity of your life,” invites viewers to join a “great team of leaders,” and offers WhatsApp or Facebook contact for prospective participants in Mexico City. The description adds a route into the miners’ platform through an educational package. Together, these statements present recruitment into OneCoin through a paid-access package and leadership network, supporting the recruitment structure at issue. The video itself supplies the invitation and entry route, while the cited program-level context describes the package sales and multi-level recruitment commissions; it does not show the speaker presenting a commission table or establish particular losses or outcomes.
